_comment: Local static trusted-issuer fixture for standalone Wave 4 runs only (service-skeleton-conventions.md sec 5: 'point it at a local static JWKS fixture if the gateway isn't implemented yet'). Shape: {issuer: {kid: {public_key, alg}}}. Empty by default -- PS_AUDIT_TRUSTED_ISSUERS (inline JSON or a file path) overrides this entirely in every real environment. Never put a real key in this file; it ships in the public repo.

ps-outbox-relay-dev._comment: Dev-only keypair shared by outbox-relay/safepayai_common.outbox (NOT a secret, matches that module's DEV_AUDIT_RELAY_PRIVATE_KEY_PEM). Every producer service signs its outbox-relay JWT with this key by default so docker-compose/CI work out of the box; a real deployment overrides PS_<SLUG>_OUTBOX_RELAY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY per service and replaces this entry's public key / trusted-issuer config to match.
